name: agent-spinners
description: Band above the prompt listing subagents and background tasks (Bash and PowerShell commands, monitors) with braille spinners while they run

notifyWhenIdle.title: Notify when idle
notifyWhenIdle.description: Send a notification when Claude stops with no background tasks left running. On Windows Terminal, set Notifications to terminal_bell in /config to see it as a bell on the tab.
